form_cues: Hands on hips, feet shoulder-width apart
Make large slow circles with your hips
routine.sourceQuote: We start by opening up those hips — big slow circles, both ways

form_cues: Arms fully extended, start small and get bigger

routine.sourceQuote: Finish with light air squats — just getting the blood flowing into those legs
